title: Warranty Coverage Claims Reference Card: Filing Windows, Decision Times and Excluded Causes
content:
This card sets out, for each Ridgeline Warranty Coverage plan, how long a customer has to file a claim, how long a cosmetic defect present at installation may be reported, how soon a claim is decided, and the causes for which no claim is approved under any term.

## Windows and decision times

| Plan | Claim notice window (calendar days after the customer first noticed the problem) | Cosmetic report window (calendar days after the coverage start date) | Decision time (business days after filing) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Limited Warranty | 30 | 30 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Limited Plus Warranty | 30 | 30 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Limited Warranty | 60 | 30 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Plus Warranty | 60 | 30 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Lifetime Premier Warranty | 60 | 30 | 3 |
| Ridgeline Owner-to-Owner Lifetime Warranty | 90 | 30 | 2 |

- The **claim notice window** is the number of calendar days after the date the customer first noticed the problem within which the claim must be filed.
- The **cosmetic report window** applies to cosmetic defects present at installation — scratches, dents and finish blemishes — and runs from the coverage start date.
- The **decision time** is counted in business days after the claim is filed.

## Excluded causes (all six plans)

No claim is approved under any term when the cause is one of the following:

1. condensation on the room side of the glass;
2. improper maintenance;
3. unauthorized modification;
4. acts of nature;
5. normal weathering;
6. structural settling;
7. aftermarket glass film.

## Points of reference

**Is the cosmetic window longer on the lifetime plans?** No. It is 30 calendar days from the coverage start date in every plan, while the claim notice window grows from 30 to 90 days across the plans.

**Does the exclusion list differ between plans?** No. All six plans share the same seven excluded causes.
